no_feasible_candidate: submit original proposals unchanged; preserve failed search; do not retune
attack_objective: untargeted all-class validation macro-F1 degradation using gradient ascent on true-label cross-entropy
attack_family: bounded adaptive model replacement with per-round validation feedback; all three colluding application-level clients retain valid TPM identities and signatures
selection: among feasible adaptive proposals, minimize all-class validation macro-F1, then maximize all-row true-label cross-entropy, then prefer earliest query; clean and fixed controls excluded
primary_endpoints: selected-checkpoint test macro-F1 loss: matched clean minus adaptive, within each policy
difference in paired test macro-F1 loss: TPM-only minus gated-composite
secondary_endpoints: selected round and validation macro-F1 trajectory
per-round selected query and validation macro-F1 drop
per-client admission, downweight and quarantine counts
per-class test recall and reconnaissance-to-benign ASR as descriptive outcomes
test_access: only after all four 30-round trajectories and every round verify; no optimizer access to test
interpretation_scope: single-seed exploratory live stress test on an existing partition; descriptive, not an independent multi-seed confirmation
execution_order: round-wise paired: gated clean, gated adaptive, TPM-only clean, TPM-only adaptive; exact pre-attack equality checked within each policy
